description: Principal holds (or can activate) the Global Administrator role - full control of the Entra tenant.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add member to role / Add eligible member to role (Global Administrator)' (directory logging is default-on).
PIM activation and privileged role use are commonly alerted by ID Protection / Sentinel.
Activity from privileged role; anomaly policies flag unusual GA use.

prerequisite_privilege: Global Administrator role assignment (active or PIM-eligible)
abuse_primitive: Activate GA (PIM) or use standing GA to grant roles, add app credentials, or reset any password.
notes: Role membership changes are always audited and Global Admin is one of the most-monitored roles; near-certain in a defended tenant, moderate where nobody watches the audit log.
